plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Anthropology, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/anthropology-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Anthropology Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. Catalog edition confirmed 2026-2027 (catalog site offers 'Download PDF of the entire 2026-2027 Catalog'). Grid rows shown only as a footnote number with units (4, 5, 6) do not name a specific course in the published schedule — modeled as choice slots with the catalog's footnote number preserved in choice_note; select from the approved General Education list and program recommendations; see advisor. The 'ANTH 102 & ANTH 110L' grid row is split into its two catalog courses (3 + 1 units). Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid. Students must earn a C or better in each Anthropology course. This program can be completed online but may require in-person assignments or exams.
